thread:
kevin: hi all — first week here. need to investigate a flaky production inference route but i only have staging console access. who to ping for a temporary prod ff-admin and a scoped sa key? :wave:

people-ops-bot: Hi Kevin! For PROD access we require manager approval + JIT. Please fill the prod-access form: https://redwood.internal/prod-jit and include manager alias and justification.

kevin: filled the form, justification: 'debug intermittent 500s on /v1/infer for payments flow, ENG-12988'. submitted manager as @anya. getting a 403 when i try to request the prod toggle in the console though.

anya: hey Kevin — approved the JIT request in the form. quick note: prod JIT requests require a 2FA push confirmation from your Okta app. did you get a prompt?

kevin: nope, didn't get a push. my Okta profile shows MFA device not registered. i registered my phone now, tried again and still 403 in the console UI when hitting the toggle page. attaching small screenshot.

infra-oncall: sometimes the console enforces the `sso-prod-access` group membership for the toggle UI. people-ops needs to add you to that group before the JIT window can be opened. pinged people-ops for manual add.

people-ops-bot: Manual group add requested: add-kevin->sso-prod-access. Expected propagation ~5 min.

devtools: FYI for the SA key we'll create a short-lived key with roles: `inference.invoker`, `tracing.writer`. TTL default 4h unless you need more. We'll store it at vault path `secret/data/onboard/kevin/prod-sa` and apply rotation.

kevin: 4h works. thanks.

people-ops-bot: Group membership updated for kevin: `sso-prod-access`.

infra-oncall: JIT ready. @anya please approve the activation (console will request approval flow).

anya: approved JIT activation. go ahead infra-oncall.

infra-oncall: activating JIT session for kevin -> role `ff-admin` in PROD. window opens at 16:30 UTC for 2h. Note: all toggle actions are audited.

devtools: SA key created: alias `sa-kevin-prod-debug`, TTL=4h. Vault path: `secret/data/onboard/kevin/prod-sa`. Command we ran for reference:
```bash
# example (internal)
redwood-iam create-service-account --alias sa-kevin-prod-debug --roles inference.invoker,tracing.writer --ttl 4h --output-vault secret/data/onboard/kevin/prod-sa
```

auditor-bot: Audit log entry created: AUDIT-79321 for JIT activation and SA issuance. Toggle actions will be linked to this id.

kevin: got the vault secret and JIT window. flipping the flag now and will run targeted requests. i'll paste the audit id in the ticket when done. thanks all — appreciate the quick help. :thumbsup:

people-ops-bot: Reminder: JIT will auto-expire at end of window. If you need extended access, create a follow-up request with explicit justification.

kevin: will do. follow-up: after debug i'll open a tiny PR to add a richer flag description + runbook pointer so next person isn't blocked. closing the loop in ENG-12988. cheers! :rocket:
